sources.snippet: whisper-tiny huggingface.co whisper-tiny huggingface.co is an AI model on huggingface.co that provides whisper-tiny's model effect (), which can be used instantly with this litert-community whisper-tiny model. huggingface.co supports a free trial of the whisper-tiny model, and also provides paid use of the whisper-tiny. Support call whisper-tiny model through api, including Node.js, Python, http.
